text: 别偷偷摸摸的走来走去！
source_text: 别偷偷摸摸的走来走去！

text: Hey, you! Quit trying to hide, or get out!
source_text: Hey, you! Quit trying to hide, or get out!

text: 嘿，你！别再躲躲藏藏的了，不然就滚出去！
source_text: 嘿，你！别再躲躲藏藏的了，不然就滚出去！

text: Hey, can I ask you a few questions?
source_text: Hey, can I ask you a few questions?

text: 嘿，我能问你几个问题么？
source_text: 嘿，我能问你几个问题么？

text: Can you spare a few caps?
source_text: Can you spare a few caps?

text: I'm on duty. Make it quick.
source_text: I'm on duty. Make it quick.

text: Can you tell me about your boss?
source_text: Can you tell me about your boss?

text: 能和我聊聊你们老板么？
source_text: 能和我聊聊你们老板么？

text: What else is there around this town?
source_text: What else is there around this town?

text: What are you, stupid? Go away.
source_text: What are you, stupid? Go away.

text: 你是干什么的，傻冒？滚开。
source_text: 你是干什么的，傻冒？滚开。

text: We don't have a use for paupers here.
source_text: We don't have a use for paupers here.

text: Gizmo's a fair man. Pay's good, work's easy. Don't make trouble and everyone will be happy.
source_text: Gizmo's a fair man. Pay's good, work's easy. Don't make trouble and everyone will be happy.

text: 吉斯莫是个公平的人。给的薪水高，安排的活儿简单。别惹麻烦，这样大家都开心。
source_text: 吉斯莫是个公平的人。给的薪水高，安排的活儿简单。别惹麻烦，这样大家都开心。

text: Go catch a few drinks at the Skum Pit. Good grog. Opens at four. Now leave me alone.
source_text: Go catch a few drinks at the Skum Pit. Good grog. Opens at four. Now leave me alone.

text: 到萨姆·匹特去喝几杯吧。那儿的酒够劲。四点开门。现在走开吧。
source_text: 到萨姆·匹特去喝几杯吧。那儿的酒够劲。四点开门。现在走开吧。

text: Why don't you go shopping at Killian's? His store is southeast of here. Now beat it.
source_text: Why don't you go shopping at Killian's? His store is southeast of here. Now beat it.

text: 买东西为啥不去基利安那儿？他的店在这儿的东南边。现在走吧。
source_text: 买东西为啥不去基利安那儿？他的店在这儿的东南边。现在走吧。

text: Hey, if you wanna have a little fun, stop by the Crash House and ask for Sinthia. She's worth it.
source_text: Hey, if you wanna have a little fun, stop by the Crash House and ask for Sinthia. She's worth it.

text: 嘿，你要想找点乐子的话，在破房那儿停下，问问辛西娅。她值得起那个价。
source_text: 嘿，你要想找点乐子的话，在破房那儿停下，问问辛西娅。她值得起那个价。

text: 我想今晚我会去找辛西娅的。
source_text: 我想今晚我会去找辛西娅的。

text: Hey! You! Put your piece away!
source_text: Hey! You! Put your piece away!

text: 嘿！你！把你的家伙收起来！
source_text: 嘿！你！把你的家伙收起来！
